clusters.label: Regex Definition and Basic Metacharacters
clusters.rationale: Covers the definition of regex and listing basic metacharacters; no other candidate covers the same introductory definition at this depth.

clusters.label: Representative Metacharacters: Dot, List, Negated List
clusters.rationale: Focuses on the specific metacharacters ., [...], [^...]; distinct from quantifiers or anchors.

clusters.label: Quantifiers: *, +, ?, {x,y}
clusters.rationale: Covers repetition metacharacters; different concept from anchors, escaping, etc.

clusters.label: Anchors: ^ and $
clusters.rationale: Covers line/string boundaries; distinct from other metacharacter groups.

clusters.label: Alternation and Grouping: | and ()
clusters.rationale: Covers logical OR and subexpression grouping; unique among the candidates.

clusters.label: Escaping Metacharacters: \
clusters.rationale: Covers treating metacharacters as literals; distinct from other concepts.

clusters.label: Shorthand Character Classes: \d, \w, \s
clusters.rationale: Covers predefined character sets with shortcuts; separate from custom lists (cluster_002).

clusters.label: Python re Module Methods
clusters.rationale: Covers Python-specific regex functions; separate from language-agnostic regex syntax.

clusters.label: Practical Applications of Regex
clusters.rationale: Applies regex to real-world tasks; builds on syntax but tests application, not syntax definition.

clusters.label: Regex in JavaScript
clusters.rationale: Covers JavaScript-specific regex syntax with slashes; distinct from Python methods and general regex syntax.
